section.title: Detailed Description
section.para: Include <glm/gtc/quaternion.hpp> to use the features of this extension.
Defines a templated quaternion type and several quaternion operations.

section.title: eulerAngles()

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL vec< 3, T, Q > glm::eulerAngles (qua< T, Q > const & x)

section.para: Returns euler angles, pitch as x, yaw as y, roll as z. The result is expressed in radians.

para.computeroutput: GLM_FUNC_DECL GLM_CONSTEXPR vec< 4, bool, Q > glm::greaterThan (qua< T, Q > const & x, qua< T, Q > const & y)

section.para: Returns the component-wise comparison of result x > y.

section.para: Returns the component-wise comparison of result x >= y.
